faq: Who is Phoenix Strength?
An Australian commercial strength equipment brand, in the industry since 2009, with over 1,000 gyms fitted out. Phoenix designs its equipment and manages its own manufacturing.
Who do I contact in Europe?
L4Gym is the Phoenix Strength partner for Germany and Europe. Contact Jamie Bevan at jamie@l4gym.com or use the enquiry form.
Do you deliver outside Germany?
Yes. L4Gym quotes projects across Europe. Freight to your site is included in the written quote.
Are prices published?
No. Every project is quoted on the equipment, finishes and freight you need. L4Gym sends a written, itemised quote.
Can equipment carry our colours and logo?
Yes. Custom frame colours, upholstery and logos are available, and Phoenix builds private label equipment for gym brands.

rigs.heading: The rig is the first thing members see.
rigs.lead: Commercial rigs, power racks and half cages from one bolt-together system. Free standing, wall mounted or built to your floor plan, from one cage to a twenty station floor.

sections.heading: Built like infrastructure, not furniture.
rows: Every rig, cage and specialist build runs on the same uprights, hole spacing and attachments. Start with two cells and add more later without replacing a part.
Send a floor plan. Phoenix lays out the rig, the stations and the clearances, then quotes it line by line.
Black powder coat as standard. Custom RAL frame colours and logo plates on request, so the rig carries your identity.

sections.heading: The numbers your floor plan needs.
sections.intro: A cell is 1080 mm between uprights, 1230 mm overall with the uprights. Cells join with an 1800 mm connector section. A wall rig gives one working station per cell. A free standing rig gives two, so two athletes train off the same frame. Each station takes a 7 ft Olympic bar, or a 6 ft or 5 ft bar in tighter spaces.

faq: Can you design a rig for our floor plan?
Yes. Send your floor plan with ceiling height and any columns or doors. Phoenix lays out the rig and stations around your space and L4Gym sends the quote.
What is the rig specification?
75 x 75 mm SHS uprights with 4 mm or 3 mm wall, 25 mm holes at 25 mm centres, heights from 2500 to 3500 mm, rated to 500 kg.
Do Phoenix attachments fit our existing rig?
Phoenix attachments fit any rig built to the same 75 x 75 mm, 25/25 hole standard, including Valkyrie rigs. Send photos of your uprights and we will check.
How are rigs delivered?
Rigs ship bolt-together and palletised. Freight to your site is quoted with the project.
Can the rig be in our colours?
Yes. Black powder coat is standard. Custom RAL frame colours and logo plates are quoted with your order.

faq: Should we choose plate-loaded or pin-loaded machines?
Most commercial gyms use both. Plate loaded for heavy leg and back work, pin loaded for fast changeovers on busy floors. Tell us your members and floor size and we will suggest a mix.
Can we choose frame and upholstery colours?
Yes. Black frame with black upholstery is standard. Frame colour, upholstery colour and diamond stitching are quoted with your order.
What happens if a part breaks?
Spare parts are held and shipped and the warranty is honoured. Warranty terms are confirmed in writing with your quote.
How are machines shipped to Europe?
Machines ship palletised. Freight to your site is quoted per project.
Why are prices not published?
Every order is quoted on the machines, finishes and freight for your project. L4Gym sends a written quote.
